description.en: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last second defense when attacked.
description.zh: 闪耀藤蔓能促进其依附的阳光植物的生产，使它们在生产时产出更多的阳光，月光花除外。在受到威胁的时候用阳光闪晕身边的僵尸作为防御。

chat.en: "Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
chat.zh: “躲猫猫！” 闪耀藤蔓咯咯笑着，直勾勾地盯着屏幕前的你。“就当这第四面墙已经碎了吧！”

text.en: best used on sun producer plants
text.zh: 最好种植在生产植物上
不会促进月光花的生产
